nodes.label: Landmark Case Coverage & Scope Boundary (Section 74)
nodes.rationale: Clarifies that the 43 recorded cases represent comprehensively verified landmark cases meeting judicial evidentiary thresholds rather than the universe of all corruption.

nodes.label: Zero-Hallucination & Provenance Research Methodology (Master Prompt v2026.09)
nodes.norm_label: zero-hallucination & provenance research methodology (master prompt v2026.09)
nodes.rationale: Eliminates AI hallucinations by requiring official judicial provenance, distinguishing prosecutor demands from court verdicts, enforcing strict financial anti-double-counting, and keeping 10 presidential eras purely chronological.

nodes.label: Financial Anti Double-Counting Guardrail
nodes.rationale: Prohibits summing project/contract values or BPK/BPKP audit figures with court-recognized state losses on the same case to ensure accurate public financial reporting.

nodes.label: Presumption of Innocence Guardrail (Pasal 8 ayat 1 UU No. 48/2009)
nodes.norm_label: presumption of innocence guardrail (pasal 8 ayat 1 uu no. 48/2009)
nodes.rationale: Protects suspects and defendants from defamation before final inkrah verdicts by forbidding 'koruptor' labels, excluding non-inkrah cases from Hall of Shame, and mandating DisclaimerBanner.

nodes.label: Primary Source Provenance Mandate
nodes.rationale: Requires 100% of cases and financial records to link to official judicial/audit URLs (MA Putusan, SIPP, KPK, Kejaksaan, BPK) or Dewan Pers-verified media.

nodes.label: Serverless PostgreSQL Dual-Connection Pooling (Pooler vs Direct)
nodes.norm_label: serverless postgresql dual-connection pooling (pooler vs direct)
nodes.rationale: Uses port 6543 transaction pooler (prepare: false, max: 3) for serverless runtime to prevent connection exhaustion under traffic spikes, reserving port 5432 DIRECT_URL for Drizzle CLI migrations and seeding.

nodes.label: Server-First SSR/ISR & Tag-Based Cache Revalidation
nodes.rationale: Replaces v1 client-only SPA state routing with Next.js App Router RSC/ISR and unstable_cache tags so /kasus/[slug] and /tokoh/[slug] are SEO-indexable and invalidate instantly on admin mutations.

nodes.label: Database-Backed site_settings Table
nodes.rationale: Permanently replaces local announcement.json and donation.json file writes that fail or vanish in read-only/ephemeral Vercel serverless environments.

nodes.label: Unified 28-Table Drizzle ORM Data Model
nodes.rationale: Eliminates v1 three-layer schema divergence between InMemoryDB, flat schema, and canonical SQL by mapping all 13 research datasets alongside citizen, RBAC, audit, and operational tables.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL-Backed Distributed Rate Limiting (rate_limit_buckets)
nodes.rationale: Replaces v1 in-memory express-rate-limit that resets on Vercel cold starts with persistent 5-tier Postgres buckets (auth_strict, write_citizen, export_heavy, ai_curator, public_read).

nodes.label: HttpOnly Secure Cookie JWT & Server-Verified Google OAuth
nodes.norm_label: httponly secure cookie jwt & server-verified google oauth
nodes.rationale: Replaces v1 localStorage JWTs to prevent XSS token theft and verifies Google ID tokens server-side with OAuth2Client.verifyIdToken to prevent client email spoofing.

nodes.label: Fail-Fast Zod Env Validation & Removal of Default Credentials
nodes.norm_label: fail-fast zod env validation & removal of default credentials
nodes.rationale: Eliminates v1 hardcoded JWT fallback secrets and the admin123 default password by failing fast at startup and requiring CLI super_admin bootstrapping.

nodes.label: v1-legacy-archive Tagging & Asset Preservation Policy
nodes.rationale: Preserves v1 commit history via git tag v1-legacy-archive and keeps data/, docs/, and provincesGeo.ts intact while removing legacy Vite/Express files to prevent dead code or dependency conflicts.

nodes.label: v1 Technical Audit (4 Structural Root Causes)
nodes.norm_label: v1 technical audit (4 structural root causes)
nodes.rationale: Documents the four v1 architectural flaws motivating the v2.0 ground-up rebuild: 3-layer data duplication, SPA lack of SSR/ISR, serverless local JSON file anti-pattern, and hardcoded secret/localStorage security gaps.
